info.title: Planninq code forge links
info.description: Links GitHub commits and pull requests to planninq tasks. Import it in integriq, then add the webhook URL and secret in GitHub. Integriq writes a forgeLink with the forge text in taskKey; planninq finds the task key in it. See planninq's admin settings, Code forges.

planninq-github-forge-link.name: GitHub event to planninq code link
planninq-github-forge-link.description: A push (its head commit) or a pull request event becomes one planninq forgeLink. A later event about the same pull request carries the same externalId, and planninq replaces the older link.

mapping.taskKey: {% if pull_request is defined %}{{ pull_request.title }} {{ pull_request.head.ref }}{% else %}{{ head_commit.message }} {{ ref }}{% endif %}
mapping.kind: {% if pull_request is defined %}mergeRequest{% else %}commit{% endif %}
mapping.url: {% if pull_request is defined %}{{ pull_request.html_url }}{% else %}{{ head_commit.url }}{% endif %}
mapping.title: {% if pull_request is defined %}{{ pull_request.title }}{% else %}{{ head_commit.message|split("\n")|first }}{% endif %}
mapping.externalId: {% if pull_request is defined %}github:{{ repository.full_name }}#{{ pull_request.number }}{% else %}{{ head_commit.id }}{% endif %}
mapping.state: {% if pull_request is defined %}{% if pull_request.merged %}merged{% else %}{{ pull_request.state }}{% endif %}{% endif %}
mapping.author: {% if pull_request is defined %}{{ pull_request.user.login }}{% else %}{{ head_commit.author.username|default(head_commit.author.name) }}{% endif %}
mapping.occurredAt: {% if pull_request is defined %}{{ pull_request.updated_at }}{% else %}{{ head_commit.timestamp }}{% endif %}

planninq-github-signature.name: Check the GitHub signature
planninq-github-signature.description: Refuses a delivery whose X-Hub-Signature-256 does not match the secret. Fill in the secret after the import; it is the one you enter in GitHub.

planninq-github-webhook.name: GitHub webhook for planninq
planninq-github-webhook.description: Receives GitHub push and pull request events and writes planninq code links.
